awwv_meta.source: Balkan Battlegrounds Vol. I Appendices G & H; corrected Feb 9, 2026
awwv_meta.rule: Strict alignment with Appendix H (ARBiH), Appendix G (VRS), and HVO Master List.
corrections_applied: Fixed all 46 VRS 1st Krajina Corps assignments
Fixed all 11 VRS 2nd Krajina Corps assignments
Added 3 missing VRS Drina Corps brigades
Fixed HVO OZ assignments for all brigades
Fixed 15 HRHB brigades with vrs_herzegovina -> correct HVO OZ
Added available_from turn number to all 261 brigades
Added mandatory: true for all turn-0 brigades
Game design: ARBiH 6th/7th Corps do not exist; 3rd/4th Corps brigades available_from set to 0 (not late by corps).
Historical recalibration (2026-02-25): Per-brigade initial_personnel and initial_cohesion based on BB historical data.
RBiH: 4-tier formation timing (tier0 immediate/tier1 early/tier2 corps reorg/tier3 late) with personnel 350-800, cohesion 38-56.
HRHB: By OZ (SE Herzegovina strongest, Central Bosnia weakest) with personnel 650-950, cohesion 52-64.
RBiH brigades not in threatened areas moved to available_from >= 4 (gradual TO→brigade formation).
Removed all 27 territorial_defense formations (2026-02-26): redundant gap-fillers replaced by militia pool system.
